invocation: FOUNDRY_PROFILE=halmos18 halmos --forge-build-out out-halmos18 --match-contract ^<C>$ --loop 32 --solver-threads 2 --solver-max-memory 512 --solver-timeout-assertion 60s --solver-timeout-branching 5s --statistics, wrapped in systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=4G -p CPUQuota=400%; one contract at a time, sequential, free -m >= 1500MB gate (observed ~8.9 GB available each run); PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1. Profile [profile.halmos18] added to work/foundry.toml with the run-17 stale-file skip list (halmos runs its own forge build and has no skip flag).
model: Independent Router NG v1.1 model work/test/invariant/run18/RouterNGv11Model.sol. Halmos uses RouterModelBF (in SetRouteSymbolic.t.sol): a line-for-line transcription with the flag updates made branch-free (assembly or). Hop loop and break unchanged. Reason: the original if-per-flag form path-explodes under halmos (ModelProbe alone made no progress in 300s; real S1 made none in 600s); BF probe PASS 21 paths 0.13s.
revertHandling: setRoute called via low-level call; ok==false paths return explicitly; asserts only on ok==true, so halmos revert-pruning cannot hide the accept branch. Sanity check confirms accept branch reachable (5 witnesses, k=1..5).
findingsNote: No new findings. The two FAILs on the real adapter are expected residual confirmations of existing items (LOCAL-001/L-07, LOCAL-002), concretely replayed in forge.

mutantControlsNote: Anti-vacuity holds. NoGapCheck: only S3 (plus residuals/sanity) fails, exactly matching the run-18 forge/medusa campaign. Legacy: S1-S4 all FAIL (matches campaign). Legacy unbounded full run killed after 28 min with 0 tests complete and --early-exit unbounded killed after 11 min (2^11 branching on legacy last-non-zero loop); witnesses therefore obtained over the bounded domains stated. Legacy storedEqualsInput/completeness/residual checks were not run on the legacy mutant (not needed for anti-vacuity; mutants only relax the validator).

skipped.reason: Against a real ERC4626 the path has >=2 symbolic divisions (convertToShares mulDiv, convertToAssets mulDiv, minOut bps division) - known intractable (memory halmos-two-divisions-intractable). With the vault abstracted the claim reduces to min(x, balance) <= x, a structural identity with no evidential value. Evidence for I9 remains the forge/medusa campaign (absence of evidence only).

caveats: Proofs are relative to the RouterNGv11Model abstraction of Router NG v1.1 (structural loop/break/read-set only; not verified against router bytecode this run). They do not cover swap-time behaviour (pool i/j vs coin consistency, amountOut checks - L-12 stays open).
Proofs cover the NEW validator at HEAD only. The live mainnet adapter 0x2D02...D6f runs the legacy validator, which the Legacy mutant run shows violates S1-S4 (T-4 operational hazard).
Completeness proof uses the model swap_type range 1..8; setRoute also accepts out-of-range types (LOCAL-002), so acceptance set strictly contains the clean set.
